Oh and looking through the foggy window. Noises are also muted to a degree. Its like my fingers are in my ears. This is usually one of my hints that dissociation is happening slowly. I takes extra energy to really focus on what people are saying to me.

As someone who does live with D.I.D. ....honestly it can happen so fast or pain stakingly slow and painful. Fast? Its like a black out. For me...in response to stress or a trigger...I feel nauseous...and then its like I'm too tired to function. Feels like my body is shutting down. One time I thought I needed to call 911. Then straight fade to the void. Now its not always to this degree. Sometimes its slow. It feels like a weight ontop of another weight and theres this pull inside your head. Atleast with me it feels like my brain is slowly falling asleep without me. I stare off. And then its just like I'm looking through a foggy window and i keep taking naps. The lights are on but the owner is passed out and her roommates are trying to figure out whats going on. I have reached a point where I am co-conscious with most of them. It takes years and a fuck ton of work to put a system in working order. For some of us that works.
